assessment.name: Context Integrity Assessment
assessment.deliveryWindow: 2–4 business days after all required inputs are received
acceptance: The agreed workflow was reviewed.
All listed assessment deliverables were supplied.
At least one representative sample path was documented.
Observed context-integrity risks and dependencies were stated.
The findings walkthrough was completed or waived in writing.
outOfScope: Truth verification or general model evaluation

single-workflow.name: Single-Workflow Integration
acceptance: Current high-confidence context behaves as agreed.
Stale context is surfaced and handled according to the configured policy.
Weak or unknown dating is not silently treated as current.
Provenance or source-confidence weakness remains visible.
Failure or unknown state is reported honestly rather than converted to healthy state.
outOfScope: SSO, SCIM, or enterprise control plane
Broad custom UI or marketplace work

private-multi.name: Private / Multi-Workflow Implementation
private-multi.deliveryWindow: Typically 2–4 weeks after READY_TO_START, subject to access and dependencies
acceptance: Each in-scope workflow is integrated at the agreed insertion point.
Each workflow passes its signed acceptance schedule.
The agreed evidence or decision output is produced.
An operator runbook is supplied.
Known limitations and residual risks are documented.
The client can reproduce the agreed operation in the agreed environment.
outOfScope: SOC 2, ISO, or other compliance certification
Regulated-data processor obligations not separately agreed
General governance dashboard or model-safety certification

build-to-spec.name: Build-to-Spec Implementation
build-to-spec.deliveryWindow: Milestone schedule defined in the signed specification
acceptance: Each milestone has an observable acceptance test.
The implemented capability matches the signed technical specification.
Dependencies and known limitations are documented.
Open-source and third-party components are disclosed.
Handover material is supplied for the agreed deployment.
outOfScope: Exclusivity or assignment unless separately executed
Buyer rights not expressly stated in the signed agreement
